title: Optimistic like button
summary: Show the result before the server answers with `useOptimistic`, and roll back on failure.
prompt: Finish `LikeButton`. Clicking "Like (N)" shows N + 1 immediately with `useOptimistic`, then awaits `sendLike()`, which resolves to the saved count. On success, show the saved count. On failure, fall back to the last confirmed count and show `role="alert"` with "Could not save your like."
hints: Wrap state updates that run after an `await` in another `startTransition`. When the action finishes, the optimistic value falls back to the real state automatically.
